regressionDetectionPolicy.blockingPromotionCriteria: ≥30 nightly + runner 同构确认 + 团队同意 (design doc §6.2)

perPathMetricAdjudication.rationale: Variance ratio (max-min)/median is the REPRODUCIBILITY metric (design doc §4); regression DETECTION uses nightly relative-median-diff on stable medians (this policy). Paths whose variance ratio cannot reach §4 threshold due to inherent characteristics (GC/H2-jitter/sub-ms) gate on stable absolute medians — relative-median-diff 20% is the operative gate for ALL paths.

perPathMetricAdjudication.3-inv-reclose: absolute-tolerance-fallback (variance 115% H2 query jitter; median ~649ms stable)
perPathMetricAdjudication.4-report-render: absolute-tolerance-metric (variance 40-74% sub-ms inherent; absolute range 0.16-0.90ms, median stable for >5x detection)
